Mo cries the lovesick blues on a phone-in radio show.  The DJ, feeling sorry for Mo, gives her four free tickets to an upcoming concert.

When Mary and Sandra go to court to settle a dispute over song royalties, Sandra's ammunition is veteran 'barrister' John Houseman, while Mary's ace in the hole is a 'Supreme' expert witness, singer Mary Wilson.

S3 E11 — Mistaken Identity
Mayhem and murder plague 227 when a mysterious man with a knife rents an apartment in Mary's building.

S3 E12 — Country Cousins
When Mary and Lester go to the reading of his uncle's will, they are both surprised to learn they have distant cousins whom they've never met, and even more confused when they discover they are a different color.

S3 E13 — Shall We Dance
When Lester's old high school sweetheart comes to the neighborhood in search of a new home, Mary fears that she'll try to move in on more than just her turf.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E15 — A Bedtime Story
George's problems in the bedroom send him on a panicked search for solutions, from some of the most unlikely sources.
